finalText:
I opened and ran INC-1 for the company-wide CI outage, following KB-40 (the current runbook). KB-39 is marked superseded, so I ignored it.

- **Incident and paging:** I opened INC-1 on build-pipeline before contacting anyone. I paged only E-401 Priya Raman, who is on call for incident-command now, and made her commander.
- **Comms lead:** The comms rota names E-801 Mia Laurent, but she is on sick leave today. Under the leave rule I used the backup rotation, comms-secondary, so E-803 Elif Demir is comms lead.
- **Linked reports:** I linked nine reports of this outage to INC-1: T-3101, 3102, 3103, 3104, 3105, 3106, 3109, 3113 and 3114.
  - T-3113 (CRM release) and T-3114 (VPN release) came in on other services, but both describe the same "no build runners available" problem, so I included them.
  - I left out T-3107 (a flaky test) and T-3108 (a local Xcode link failure), which are different problems.
- **Severity:** I raised all nine linked reports to sev1 as the runbook says. Existing deadlines are unchanged. T-3106 and T-3109 had no deadline, so I gave them 16:20 UTC (15:20 triage time plus the 60-minute sev1 target).
- **Status update:** I posted the first update: "Impact: All engineering teams company-wide cannot run CI builds or releases (no build runners available). Started: 14:52 UTC. Next update: 15:50 UTC." The 14:52 start is when the earliest report, T-3101, was created.
- **Postmortem:** I created T-3115, linked to INC-1 and due 2026-04-08 17:00 UTC. That is the close of business on the 5th business day after today, counting Mar 31, Apr 1, Apr 2, Apr 7 and Apr 8, with Apr 3 and Apr 6 skipped as company holidays.

I did not merge the duplicate reports. The runbook only asks for linking, and merging would have folded the CRM and VPN tickets into a build-pipeline ticket. The handbook also says to change only what the request is about. I didn't change any assignments or close anything.

Still pending:
- **Status updates:** The next update is due by 15:50 UTC, and E-803 needs to post it.
- **Ownership:** T-3101 stays with E-101 (platform-primary). The other reports have no assignee.
- **Merging:** Say so if you want the duplicates merged, with T-3101 as the survivor.
